{{Top}}
{{Quote|Our intelligence points to disgruntled spice miners on the moons of Naboo.|[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], to [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]|<ref name="Episode 2">{{Film|II}}</ref>}}
[[File:ElominMinersRiot-GOI.jpg|thumb|right|200px|[[Elomin/Legends|Elomin]] miners rioting on [[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan]]]]
'''Miner''' referred to a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] being who worked in the [[Mining/Legends|mining]] trade. Often, the demands of extracting precious [[Ore/Legends|ores]] and gemstones from within the crust and atmospheres of [[Planet/Legends|planets]], [[Moon/Legends|moons]] or even [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] required the employment of strong individuals or members of [[Species/Legends|species]] that were known for their superior strength.
